subject_specific_evidence.lab_subject_1:P4: Worst channel in all 93 epochs above 1000 uV peak-to-peak; failure concentrated in the final two condition windows.
subject_specific_evidence.lab_subject_9:P4: Worst channel in 8 of 10 epochs above 750 uV peak-to-peak; contamination includes five of seven baseline epochs and the third condition window.

interpolation.description: Spherical spline interpolation for EEG channels.

ica.selection_rule: Exclude at most three components meeting both absolute Fp1/Fp2 source correlation >= 0.35 and frontal topography dominance >= 1.5. Human visual review remains mandatory.

epoch_rejection.reason: Use the same 1050 uV epoch contract as the no-ICA primary branch so the ICA comparison isolates component removal.
